hikes.name: Mount Adams South Climb
hikes.blurb: Washington's second-highest peak without ropes for most: a long snow climb past the Lunch Counter to a flat 12,276-foot summit (climbing permit).

hikes.name: Killen Creek to High Camp
hikes.blurb: Up meadows on Adams' north side to a high bench right under the Adams Glacier's icefall.

hikes.name: Bird Creek Meadows
hikes.blurb: Wildflower meadows and waterfalls on Yakama Nation land, to a rim above Hellroaring Canyon and the Mazama Glacier.

hikes.name: Thomas Lake and Indian Heaven Lakes
hikes.blurb: Into Indian Heaven's maze of lakes and huckleberry meadows on a gentle volcanic plateau.

hikes.name: Sleeping Beauty
hikes.blurb: A short, steep climb to an old lookout site on a rock knob facing Mt Adams.

hikes.name: Sawtooth Mountain
hikes.blurb: Above the huckleberry fields to a jagged ridge with Adams, St Helens, Rainier and Hood.
